Serving Lincoln Park · Chicago

PERSONAL TRAINING FOR LINCOLN PARK

Private 1-on-1 coaching two blocks north of the Diversey border. Close enough to walk, quiet enough to actually focus.

Two Blocks North of Diversey

Our studio sits at 2900 N Broadway St, right where Lakeview meets Lincoln Park. If you're near Diversey, it's around the corner. From Fullerton, DePaul or the heart of the neighborhood, it's a straight shot up Clark or Broadway that most clients make in five to ten minutes, and the #22 and #36 buses drop you within a block of our door. Coming from a workout on the Lakefront Trail? We're a short ride inland.

We kept the studio private on purpose. No crowds, no waiting for equipment, no distractions: one client, one coach, thirty focused minutes. Early birds book the 5am weekday slots before heading to the office; everyone else finds a time that fits, with evenings until 9pm and Saturday mornings available. Get directions.

Lincoln Park Training FAQs

Is the studio actually in Lincoln Park?

We're just over the border in Lakeview, at 2900 N Broadway St, about two blocks north of Diversey Pkwy. From most of Lincoln Park that's a five to ten minute trip straight up Clark or Broadway, which is why so many of our clients come from the neighborhood.

How do I get there from Lincoln Park without driving?

The #22 Clark and #36 Broadway buses run straight up from Lincoln Park and stop within about a block of the studio. The Diversey Brown Line stop is roughly a ten minute walk, and it's an easy bike ride up Clark or over from the Lakefront Trail.

Do you have appointment times that work around a packed schedule?

That's the point of our format. We open at 5am Monday through Friday so you can train before work, run evenings until 9pm Monday through Thursday, and offer Saturdays from 7am to 3pm. Sessions are 30 minutes and by appointment only, so there's no wasted time.

What does personal training cost?

Our pricing is published on the site, tiered by how often you train, and the 30-minute session format keeps the per-session cost manageable. Check the current plans on our studio services page. Your first consultation is free either way.

Can I train without coming to the studio?

Yes. Our online coaching program delivers custom workouts, nutrition plans and daily check-ins through your phone, with the same coaches. It's a popular option for clients who split time between home, the office and travel.
